_note: One-screen, one-mechanic recipes. dontBuild is the scope-creep guard; threeSecond is the 3-second rule (player, enemy, goal must be obvious). engine 2d uses kit/gp2d.js, 3d uses gp3d.js.

recipes.title: FLAP CAT
oneUps: Gaps shrink and speed climbs with an 'x2 SPEED' banner
Pitch rises on every pipe in a streak
dontBuild: no menus beyond start and restart
recipes.threeSecond: player=orange jetpack cat, enemy=green pipes, goal=fly through the gaps

viral.hook: Mid-air flap toward a tight pipe gap
viral.bot: Attempt 0 clips pipe 3; Attempt 1 threads 12 pipes with near-miss slow-mo
viral.escalation: Speed +5% per pipe, gap shrinks, pitch rises
viral.climax: Freeze on near miss, mega chime on high score
viral.personality: Cocky speedrunner who trash-talks the pipes, then threads them perfectly

feel.why: Single-input games live or die on zero-latency forgiveness: input buffering is the whole game.
